headResult.description:
The top-level result (corresponding to the user's original query) from which most UI elements will use for
rendering.

allSources.description:
All {@link Genai.Query.Result#sourceRelations} from the #headResult plus any that may exist on its
{@link Genai.Query.Result#childResults}.

allRationaleSources.description:
All {@link Genai.Query.Result#rationaleSources} from the #headResult plus any that may exist on its
{@link Genai.Query.Result#childResults}.

allVisualizations.description:
The {@link Genai.Query.Result#visualization} from the #headResult plus any that may exist on its
{@link Genai.Query.Result#childResults}.

childResultsForUi.description: All {@link Genai.Query.Result.BaseResultForUi} for the direct children of this query.
